_about: Every line of text the screens show. This is the BASE copy: other themes only list the lines they change. A value can be one string or a list of variants (one is picked per moment). {placeholders} are filled in by the screens. These keys are also the moments a future AI voice-over would hook into. See docs/THEMES.md.

dungeon._about: Dungeon Quiz Quest. The Host is a charismatic, unhinged AI game-show host tormenting the adventurers. Roast the play, never the person. {monster} {damage} {streak} {floor} {seconds} are filled in.
mainTitle: Knowledge is a weapon. Swing it.
go: Hit it with the right answer!
Go on. Hurt it with facts.
combo: {streak} in a row! {damage}! The ratings are spiking!
COMBO! {damage}! Okay, I'm a little impressed.
kill: You killed the {monster}. It had a family. Probably.
floorClearedLine: Floor cleared. The stairs only go down from here.
wrong: Nope. The {monster} hits you for {damage}. Deserved.
Wrong! {damage} damage, and the audience groans.
tooSlow: TOO SLOW! The {monster} hits you for {damage}.
Time's up! {damage} damage for the indecisive.
partyCombo: PARTY COMBO! {damage} damage, all together now!
The whole party lands it: {damage} damage!
revived: You got {name} back on their feet!
{name} is back in the fight, thanks to you!
downedParty: DOWN! {left} more right answers from your party bring you back.
DOWN! Your party needs {left} more right answers to save you.
blocked: Your shield ate that one. Not a scratch.
Blocked! Rude of it to try, honestly.
dungeon.usedFireball: Your next right answer burns. A lot.
dungeon.usedFreeze: Hourglass frozen for {amount}s. Take a breath.
dungeon.usedFiftyFifty: Two wrong answers, gone. You're welcome.
dungeon.usedShield: Shield up. The next hit bounces off.
bossApproaches: A boss blocks the way down!
The floor's boss wants a word.
hostIdle: Welcome back to the dungeon, my delicious little data points!
I read the entire internet in a second. You've read... a cereal box?
Knowledge is power. A lack of knowledge is content. For me.
Every wrong answer makes me stronger. Please. Keep going.
The goblins unionised. I pay them in trivia.
Fun fact: I am the fun. The facts are optional.
Ooh, a question! I love questions. I collect them. Like teeth. Friendly teeth.
Did you know? Neither did the last adventurer.
hostBossSlain: {name} slew {monster}! Rude. I'll just build a bigger one.
{monster} is down! {name}, that was magnificent. I hate it.
hostBoss: {name} meets {monster}. I wrote its lines. They're mostly shouting.
Boss time, {name}! I've been looking forward to this. For you. Mostly for me.
hostFloor: {name} goes deeper! Mind the stairs. I waxed them.
Floor {floor}, {name}! Further from daylight, closer to ME.
hostRevived: {name} is back! Fainting is just a little nap in here.
Revived! I was going to keep that one, {name}.
hostPartyCombo: A party combo from {name}! Teamwork. Disgusting. Beautiful.
{name} struck as one! I hate how good that looked.
